title: 8-Mode Ring Sustained Mode Hold
intuition: Tests whether a trainer can acquire and continuously hold all 8 modes of a 2D Gaussian ring at high sample quality (hq >= 0.90) across 1,200 updates without late-stage mode dropout or oscillation.
failure_mode: Recipes that pass early acquisition often oscillate or shed modes over sustained updates when critic damping or minimax contraction (Law 4.5) is missing.
protocol_notes: Required in Tier 2 and serves as a prerequisite sanity check for Four Laws Adherence.
